1.consolidated_definition: Diseño de tela con dibujos de animales. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Ponerme un animal print era algo que antes no me hubiera atrevido a hacer... ahora es diferente, porque ya no encuentro ninguna razón para estar tapándome (El Nuevo Día, 04-09-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Animal print design: a raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Wearing an animal print was something I wouldn't have dared to do before... now it's different, because I no longer find any reason to cover myself up (El Nuevo Día, 04-09-05) 

Design of fabric with animal drawings.
